Duration: April 24th to May 3rd

1、Endless Mode: When you reach level 19, you can choose to enter the Endless Challenge through a door.

2、Two New Bosses:

Screw jeans and Claw nuts Boss
Hot dog Jason Boss

3、Five New Hero Characters: Each character comes with exclusive accessory items

Queen
Merchant
Alien
DJ
Cthulhu

As mentioned in our previous thank-you letter, we have been actively working on game updates and optimizations, maintaining a high frequency of updates to bring "Banana Brothers" to you in a better form. Here is the announcement of the updates released today!

Bug Fixes:

1、Fixed the issue where rewards could be claimed multiple times after level settlement.
2、Re-adjusted the hit and damage range of the boss.

notes.title: "Bronana" Patch update and future plan
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Players,[/b]

We have received your feedback regarding your gameplay experience, and we deeply apologize for the issues you’ve encountered so far. We have carefully reviewed all reported bugs and are committed to fixing them as soon as possible. Right now, we are working tirelessly to resolve those bugs and optimize content to ensure a smoother experience for our players. We will make sure to test all bug fixes and adjustments before rolling out the next patch.

Now, let’s take a look at the details of this upcoming patch:

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
1、Fixed the issue where the Demon interface could not be turned off.
2、Fixed tips not fully displaying under accessories.
3、Resolved issues with fullscreen mode not working properly.
4、Fixed a problem where null items could drop at the end of a stage.
5、Improved the fidelity of the Beggar’s chest texture.

[b]Gameplay Improvements:[/b]

1、Increased the influence of luck on the roulette wheel.
2、Adjusted the reforge process so that the armor set affects the stat weight.
3、The roulette now has a chance to drop two accessories instead of one.
4、Reduced the price of the Midas’ skill cost.
5、WASD keys can now be used as an alternative to arrow keys for UI navigation.
6、Health bars are now hidden when the character is at full health.

These fixes and improvements are based on the valuable feedback we recently received and hope these changes will meet your expectations! 

We are continuing to work hard on more updates in the future as we listed below, and our goal is to provide a smoother, more enjoyable experience for all players.

[b]Future Update Plans:[/b]

● Adjustments to the Banana Tree (meta-progression system).
● Difficulty and monster stat balancing.
● Adjustments to boss invincibility and health lockout.
● Behavior logic adjustments for the "Grilled Squid" monster.
● Allowing players to retry boss battles after death.
● Weapon stat reevaluations.
● Adjustments to NPC interactions regarding negative stats.

We expect to complete these updates by[b] December 17th US/December 18th CST (UTC+8).[/b]

The plans listed above specifically address the core issues recently reported by players. At the same time, we will continue to expand and optimize the game’s content and playability. A new[b] roadmap [/b]outlining our detailed future updates will also be released in the next week.

We sincerely thank all of our community for your enthusiastic feedback! We will continue to listen closely to your feedback and respond quickly, conducting thorough testing and optimization to improve the overall experience, and will do our best to meet the expectations, delivering a game you enjoy and love!

notes.title: "Bronana" Official Letter of Thanks
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Players,[/b]

Hello! We are busybear, the developers behind Bronana, sincerely appreciate all of you for taking the time to play our game.

First and foremost, we would like to extend an apology for the bugs and the negative experiences you may have encountered during recent gameplay. We understand that these issues led to an unpleasant experience, and we deeply regret that.

We have collected a large amount of feedback, and your valuable opinions are an essential basis for the future improvement and enhancement of the game’s quality. Thanks to your support, we are able to keep improving.

Before Bronana launched, we conducted many rounds of testing and version iterations to ensure the game was ready for release. However, after launch, we encountered several bugs that did not appear during testing, and certain unexpected gameplay issues that became major concerns for many players in the official release. We take full responsibility for not being able to spot those issues earlier. 

These difficulties have only continued to fuel the passion and dedication our team has for Banana and our fans. Our developers have received all the feedback and have started making changes accordingly. Since we are a small studio with only two programmers, we may not be able to address every issue right away, but please rest assured that we will review and work on every concern. We ask for your patience and hope that with each update, we can improve the overall perception of Bronana. Below are our responses to some of the key issues:

[b]Game Difficulty[/b]

Since the demo was released, we had not received enough feedback regarding the difficulty. As a result, we did not fully consider the experience of new players, which led to imbalances in the difficulty design. We will make adjustments as soon as possible to ensure that the game is enjoyable for both first-time and experienced players.

[b]Boss Health Lockout[/b]

When designing the boss battles, we intended to introduce puzzle elements to make the combat more interesting. However, we now realize that using invincibility mechanisms may have resulted in a negative experience for players. Thank you for your feedback, we will adjust the boss battles differently in future updates to enhance the gameplay experience.

[b]Meta-Progression System[/b]

We initially designed monsters and characters to grow together, and the intention was to provide additional challenges after completing difficult stages. However, this design did not receive sufficient feedback before launch, therefore the requirements for acquiring growth points were overly harsh. We have recognized this issue and will ensure that future updates will provide a more reasonable grinding system.

[b]Bugs[/b]

Once again, we apologize for the current bugs in the game. We are doing everything we can to investigate and fix these issues as soon as possible, ensuring that the above issues will not affect your gaming experience.

Thank you for your continuous support and understanding. We will keep working hard, listening to your feedback, and improving the quality of the game. We look forward to providing you with a better version of Bronana soon!


Best regards, 
busybear Team

notes.title: "Bronana" Is Out Now for $4.49 including a 10% Launch Discount!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328248/17e2b961f6100163b0e53250126cbc7ad2c8221c.jpg[/img]
Hello, everyone!

After a long journey of development, Bronana is finally here! 

[h2]Bronana is available now with a 10% launch discount, so get it now for just $4.49! Gambler Banana, Axecutioner Banana, and many other unique Banana Warriors are ready for action! [/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2492330/_/

[h1][Thank You All][/h1]

We are immensely grateful for the support and love from all of our players.

It’s been over a year since our Steam store page went live, and thanks to your feedback, we’ve been motivated to continue improving and refining the game.

Through numerous updates and patches, Bronana has grown into the game it is today. This passion project of ours is finally ready for you to play! The development journey has always been an enjoyable one for us, and we hope it brings you joy as well—giving you a fun and engaging way to spend dozens of hours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328248/0241d7ef2ea435145f10d8f1730c8ddbf74811fe.gif[/img]

[h1][New Content][/h1]

The Bronana 1.0 version arrives with countless bug fixes as well as a massive expansion of content. We’ve expanded the content to approximately four times based on the Prologue version, with a robust selection of powerful builds to explore! 

In the 1.0 version, you’ll experience:

●[b] 20+ Characters:[/b] Featuring diverse class traits like health, armor, evasion, poison, and coin-focused abilities, offering an incredibly rich variety of playstyles.
●[b] 35+ Weapons and 240+ Accessories:[/b] Progress through challenging stages, unlocking increasingly powerful weapons until you evolve into the ultimate Banana Warlord.
● [b]Brand-New NPC Interactions and Feedback: [/b]A stronger focus on gambling and randomness for a thrilling experience.
● [b]12+ Hilariously Quirky Bosses: [/b]Each boss comes with custom entrance and skill lines packed with joyful memes that will leave you laughing out loud.
● [b]A New Meta-Progression System: [/b]Enhance characters outside of runs and customize enemy difficulty for a gradual challenge—start easy and ramp up the intensity!

You can choose Midas Banana which deals damage by picking up coins, become a long-range sharpshooter like Archer Banana, or go all-in for counter-damage style, tanking hits to strike back with force. There are countless builds and strategies waiting to be tested!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328248/b8c0f42e78e378fab476f659e23c9f24430883de.gif[/img]

[h1][Future Plans][/h1]

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm! After the launch of the 1.0 version, we will continue updating the game with new content including new classes, bosses, maps, mechanics, and more.
We will also release a roadmap for future updates, so stay tuned! 
Please also join our community, where we welcome your feedback and suggestions to shape a better “Bronana” in the future!
